race.description: Garrards Horse And Hound Ladyship Pace
race.comment: HEAVENLY TURBO (8) did a great job to make it two straight wins at this distance last start at Newcastle, scoring by 10 metres. Draws on the second line this time but is going well enough to overcome that. ASCOT SHOWTIME (7) scored a win at this circuit and distance four back and could be close to anther success having finished runner-up last start, beaten 1.4 metres in a nice return to form. Primary contender. TRUTHBETOLD (1) draws perfectly and is on the radar after her last-start fourth at this circuit and distance two weeks ago. LOCHINVAR JEWELLS (2) draws well and is worth some thought after her last-start fourth from the back line.
